                    RURAL HOSPITAL PROTECTION ACT

  Ms. ARRIAGA. Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this measure. I will
vote for final passage of the Rural Hospital Protection Act, and I will
introduce an amendment next week to extend its grant program through
2032.
  Two hospitals in my district closed their obstetrics units last year.
Families now drive ninety minutes to deliver a baby. That is not an
abstraction to the people I represent; it is a Tuesday.
  I will oppose any substitute amendment that strips the grant program
out of this bill. Our communities deserve better, and together we can
deliver it.
